text: Welcome
This handbook applies to all employees of Brightwater Logistics from 1 February 2026. It replaces the handbook of 2022.
Questions about it go to the human resources team.
Working hours
The working week is 37.5 hours, from Monday to Friday.
Flexible hours
Employees may start between 7:00 and 9:30, provided that:
they are present from 9:30 to 15:00;
context: List item; Section: Working hours > Flexible hours

text: their manager has agreed to the start time;
context: List item; Section: Working hours > Flexible hours

text: they record their hours in the time system each day.
context: List item; Section: Working hours > Flexible hours

text: Overtime
Overtime is paid at 150% of the hourly rate, and needs the approval of a manager in advance.
Leave
Leave is requested in the time system at least two weeks in advance, except sick leave.
